events.title: Samsung Galaxy S25 released
events.summary: Samsung began selling the Samsung Galaxy S25 — Snapdragon 8 Elite and expanded Galaxy AI — annual flagship refresh.
events.about: The Galaxy S series remained Android's volume flagship counterweight to iPhone. Snapdragon 8 elite and expanded galaxy ai — annual flagship refresh. Developers testing Android builds routinely validated on Galaxy S hardware as the default non-Pixel reference.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy S25 continued Samsung's annual Android flagship cadence.
narrative.whyImportant: Galaxy S devices set the hardware bar millions of Android users and developers encounter.
narrative.problemSolved: Android needed consistent premium hardware for testing flagship features each year.

events.title: Rust 2024 edition released
events.summary: Rust 1.85 shipped the 2024 edition on February 20, 2025 — refining unsafe semantics, async closures, and match ergonomics.
events.about: The 2024 edition polishes Rust for systems programmers adopting async and embedded targets: clearer unsafe rules, async closures, and smoother `cargo fix --edition` migrations. Rust continues expanding in Linux, WebAssembly, and infrastructure as memory-safe languages gain regulatory momentum.

narrative.whyChosen: The 2024 edition keeps Rust evolving without the breakage trauma of other languages.
narrative.whyImportant: Safer unsafe and async ergonomics matter as Rust moves into kernels and firmware.
narrative.problemSolved: Growing Rust codebases needed clearer rules around unsafe and edition migrations.

sources.title: Rust Blog — Rust 1.85.0 and the 2024 edition (February 20, 2025)

events.title: Anthropic Claude 3.7 Sonnet released
events.summary: Anthropic released Claude 3.7 Sonnet on February 24, 2025 with extended thinking mode and improved coding and agentic capabilities.
events.about: Claude 3.7 Sonnet introduced visible extended thinking — showing reasoning steps before answers — and stronger tool-use for coding agents. It competed with OpenAI o3 and GPT-4.1 for developer copilots and autonomous workflows.

narrative.whyChosen: Claude 3.7 made extended reasoning a first-class product feature.
narrative.whyImportant: Visible thinking and tool use advanced agentic coding assistants.
narrative.problemSolved: Users could not see or trust multi-step reasoning in standard chat models.

events.title: OpenAI GPT-4.5 released
events.summary: OpenAI released GPT-4.5 on February 27, 2025 — a larger chat model with improved writing, world knowledge, and emotional intelligence before GPT-5.
events.about: GPT-4.5 was OpenAI's last major GPT-4.x chat model: warmer tone, better factual recall, and strong creative writing. It bridged GPT-4o and the unified GPT-5 system — and briefly served as the top ChatGPT tier for users who wanted scale without o-series reasoning latency.

narrative.whyChosen: GPT-4.5 was OpenAI's final large chat-model release before the GPT-5 generation.
narrative.whyImportant: It showed incremental scaling still mattered for conversational quality and knowledge work.
narrative.problemSolved: Users wanted a more capable general chat model without switching to slower reasoning modes.
